join_rule: A row appears when the 1st-string player named by a club's own published depth chart also appears on the NFL's official Week 10 injury report for that club with a Game Status of Out or Doubtful. The replacement is the next name the same club published at the same position, in the club's own column order. Neither column is an official designation: no official publisher states who will start. Where the club published no further name, the replacement is blank and flagged.

sources.club_depth_charts: one page per club, linked on every row

questionable.injury: Knee, Not injury related - resting player

alias.why: Minnesota's own chart prints 'Joshua Metellus'; the league's report prints 'Josh Metellus'. Same club, same S group.
